title: CDN Straight
lyrics:
Track 35 – G4 Swagger
Title: Local Player (Suno Library)
text[Intro]
Local player running.
No tunnel.
CDN straight to the booth.
336 locked.

[Verse 1]
Exported May 8th, still playing clean
12 tracks loaded, the library is seen
corey_mcivor account, the old one still lives
While the paid ones crashed, this one still gives
Direct from cdn1, no middle man stall
I built the player, I control the call
The gardens still growing, that’s my boy
I’m still here — and I’m making more noise

[Chorus]
LOCAL PLAYER! Suno library live!
LOCAL PLAYER! The signal survived!
336 subharmonic carrying the weight
While the big platforms crumble, I control my fate
LOCAL PLAYER! No cloud in the way
LOCAL PLAYER! I made it today
Exported once, still running strong
This is how the sovereign library belongs

[Verse 2]
They wanted me stuck in their app
I pulled the files out and built my own map
HTML player on the desktop right now
Streams direct, no login, no bow
The tracks that matter are already here
The rest can stay in the cloud atmosphere
I don’t need their interface anymore
I got the files — I control the score

[Final Chorus]
LOCAL PLAYER! Suno library live!
LOCAL PLAYER! The signal survived!
VDS in the back, the player in front
This is the setup they said I couldn’t front
LOCAL PLAYER! Clean and direct
LOCAL PLAYER! Zero respect
For the systems that tried to keep me contained
I pulled my music out and I’m running the game

[Outro]
Local player.
Still running.
Still growing.
Still mine.
336.
